Package com.sicomsa.dmt.util

Class ExtendedQueryMap

java.lang.Object
com.sicomsa.dmt.util.QueryMap
com.sicomsa.dmt.util.ExtendedQueryMap
All Implemented Interfaces:
ExtendedQuery, Query, Serializable
public class ExtendedQueryMap extends QueryMap implements ExtendedQuery
Subclass of QueryMap to implement ExtendedQuery, adding the attribute "RfcReceptor" into the query, and provides the type of query used.

1.5

  • Constructor Details

    • ExtendedQueryMap

      public ExtendedQueryMap(QueryMap.Builder builder, QueryType type)
      Creates an ExtendedQueryMap from the specified builder. It will make its own map and receptor's set in order to be inmutable.
      Parameters:
      builder - the builder that contains the query information
      type - the type of query of this map.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if builder or type are null

    • setRfcReceptor

      public void setRfcReceptor(String rfc)
      Sets the value of the "RfcReceptor" attribute with the specified value.

      RfcReceptor should only be set when requesting received certificates.

      Parameters:
      rfc - the RFC of the requestor to set.

    • addAllRfcReceptors

      public void addAllRfcReceptors(Collection<String> collection)
      Adds all rfc receptors specified in the collection to the map.

      RfcRecpetors should only be set when requesting emitted certificates.

      Parameters:
      collection - collection of rfc receptors to add to the map
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the collection is null or if any items in the collection is null.

    • clearRfcReceptors

      public void clearRfcReceptors()
      Removes all rfc receptors from this map.
